scope: S05-T01A versioned analysis knowledge snapshot and exact Chinese retrieval

implementation.source_requirement: succeeded non-stale analysis with supported viewpoints and available citations
implementation.body_generation: deterministic template from the frozen analysis DTO

verification.red: Before implementation, pytest collection exited 2 with ModuleNotFoundError because the knowledge package did not exist.
verification.backend_tests: 138 passed with disposable PostgreSQL 16 and RabbitMQ 4.1; 2 upstream deprecation warnings
verification.ruff: format and lint passed for all backend source and tests
verification.mypy: strict check passed for 120 source files
verification.frontend: UmiOpenAPI drift, directory and negative boundary checks, Prettier and TypeScript/Vite build passed
verification.dependency_audit: pip-audit found no known vulnerabilities; npm production audit found 0 vulnerabilities
verification.compose_configuration: development and production overlay configuration parsed with explicit synthetic values
verification.compose_pipeline: real Celery prefork diagnostic succeeded with epoch=1 and attempts=1
verification.browser_automation: repository Swagger and authenticated workspace scenarios passed on a clean full Compose topology
verification.browser_business_poc: a synthetic knowledge entry was displayed and found by Chinese and literal wildcard queries; a revised citation displayed stale status and hid the invalid text; desktop and 390px views had no runtime error or horizontal overflow

excluded_attempts: One stale-browser command ran npx from the repository root and loaded an unrelated temporary Playwright version; it was rerun from frontend with the locked dependency and passed.
One Compose smoke command omitted the isolated project name; it was rerun with COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME and passed.
One E2E run started only web and its dependencies, so the diagnostic job remained queued without worker and scheduler; the full topology was started on a fresh data volume and passed.
limitations: All event, content, analysis and knowledge data used by this POC were explicitly synthetic.
No external platform, real account session, existing MinIO instance, paid API or model inference was accessed.
Exact substring retrieval does not provide Chinese tokenization, semantic similarity, ranking evaluation or question answering.
This slice does not implement arbitrary authored knowledge, deletion propagation, embeddings, generated summaries or complete AC-007-011.
